headline: A preprint formalizes how to verify revocation across long-running agent work
summary: A September 18 preprint defines root-scoped authorization quiescence for agents whose work can survive in queues, callbacks, delegated credentials and provider operations. It combines a durable root-epoch cut, sink-side fences, carrier accounting and provider evidence into a bounded certificate. The paper proves conditional safety properties and reports a provider-free 17-case late-effect suite plus a separately implemented checker; the results were not independently reproduced in this review.
